name: Horizn
tagline: Every soil sample, resolved into decisions your agronomists trust.
positioning: Horizn turns raw lab panels and spectral scans into a single, auditable soil model for enterprise farming and carbon programs.

hero.h1: Stop reconciling soil data in spreadsheets.
hero.sub: Horizn ingests lab panels, VNIR scans, and field logs into one soil horizon model — so your agronomy and sustainability teams argue about strategy, not which nitrogen number is real.

features.title: One model per field
features.description: Merge lab chemistry, spectral scans, and probe readings into a single versioned soil profile — depth by depth, sample by sample.

features.title: Carbon you can defend
features.description: Quantify soil organic carbon with uncertainty bounds and full sample lineage, formatted for Verra and CDR registry review.

features.title: Lab-agnostic ingestion
features.description: Drop in CSVs from any accredited lab. Horizn maps units, flags outliers, and reconciles method drift automatically.

features.title: Audit trail on every value
features.description: Trace any nutrient reading back to the tube, the technician, and the method. Nothing in the model is unsourced.

features.title: Zone-level recommendations
features.description: Turn variability maps into per-zone amendment plans your agronomists can approve, override, and export to equipment.

features.title: API into your stack
features.description: Push resolved soil metrics into your FMIS, ERP, or carbon platform. Horizn is the source of truth, not another silo.

testimonials.quote: We were stitching together twelve lab formats by hand every quarter. Horizn gave us one soil model across 40,000 hectares and cut our reporting cycle from six weeks to four days.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: The carbon buyers wanted lineage on every organic carbon figure. Horizn produced sample-level provenance our verifier accepted without a single follow-up.
testimonials.name: Thomas Okonkwo

testimonials.quote: Method drift between labs used to quietly wreck our nitrogen trends. Horizn caught it, normalized it, and showed us the correction. That kind of honesty is rare in this space.
testimonials.name: Ingrid Vasseur
